# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)


# Define the build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

# Set the project name
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME STM32_project)

# Include toolchain file
include("cmake/gcc-arm-none-eabi.cmake")

# Enable compile command to ease indexing with e.g. clangd
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Core project settings
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})
message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

# Enable CMake support for ASM and C languages
enable_language(C ASM)

# Create an executable object type
add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}

# X-CUBE-AI 10.1.0 在当前“CubeMX + CMake”组合下会把工程内的 AI
# 目录错误写成 ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../X-CUBE-AI 和 ../Middlewares/ST/AI。
# 顶层 CMakeLists.txt 不会被 Cube 重生成，因此每次配置时在读取子目录前
# 自动纠正这两个固定前缀，避免 Generate Code 后再次出现“找不到模型源文件”。
set(CUBEMX_GENERATED_CMAKE
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/stm32cubemx/CMakeLists.txt")
if(EXISTS "${CUBEMX_GENERATED_CMAKE}")
    file(READ "${CUBEMX_GENERATED_CMAKE}" CUBEMX_GENERATED_TEXT)
    set(CUBEMX_FIXED_TEXT "${CUBEMX_GENERATED_TEXT}")
    string(REPLACE
        "\${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../X-CUBE-AI"
        "\${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/X-CUBE-AI"
        CUBEMX_FIXED_TEXT
        "${CUBEMX_FIXED_TEXT}")
    string(REPLACE
        "\${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../Middlewares/ST/AI"
        "\${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Middlewares/ST/AI"
        CUBEMX_FIXED_TEXT
        "${CUBEMX_FIXED_TEXT}")
    if(NOT CUBEMX_FIXED_TEXT STREQUAL CUBEMX_GENERATED_TEXT)
        message(STATUS "Repairing X-CUBE-AI paths generated by CubeMX")
        file(WRITE "${CUBEMX_GENERATED_CMAKE}" "${CUBEMX_FIXED_TEXT}")
    endif()
endif()

# Add STM32CubeMX generated sources
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)

# Link directories setup
target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined library search paths
)

# Add sources to executable
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user sources here
)

# Add include paths
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined include paths
)

# Add project symbols (macros)
target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined symbols
)

# Add linked libraries
# 1. 声明一个外部导入的静态库
add_library(bsec_algo STATIC IMPORTED)

# 2. 绝对绑定静态库的物理路径 (告诉 CMake 去这里拿算法实体)
set_target_properties(bsec_algo PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Lib/libalgobsec.a)

target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    stm32cubemx
    bsec_algo   # <--- 把 AI 核心库链接进来！
    m           # <--- 链接标准的 C 数学库 (算法必须用到 math.h)

    # Add user defined libraries
)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 开启 printf 的浮点数(float)打印功能
target_link_options(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -u _printf_float)
# 强制链接 C 语言标准数学库 (lm)
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}  m)
